title: Online Statistical Inference for Derivative-Free Constrained Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.31687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study statistical inference for nonlinear equality-constrained stochastic optimization problems in settings where derivative information is unavailable or expensive to obtain. While recent advances in stochastic sequential quadratic programming (SSQP) have enabled efficient online optimization, existing methods either rely on gradient information or suffer from high computational costs. To address these limitations, we develop a sketched derivative-free SSQP (SDF-SSQP) method that simultaneously achieves computational efficiency and valid statistical inference. By leveraging randomized sketching, the proposed method reduces the per-iteration computational cost to $O((d+m)^2)$, where $d$ is the dimension of the decision variable and $m$ is the number of constraints, making it well suited for large-scale problems. translated_title: 无导数约束随机优化的在线统计推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究在导数信息不可用或获取代价高昂的情形下，非线性等式约束随机优化问题的统计推断。尽管随机序列二次规划（SSQP）的最新进展已实现了高效的在线优化，但现有方法要么依赖梯度信息，要么计算成本过高。为解决这些局限，我们开发了一种基于随机投影的免导数SSQP（SDF-SSQP）方法，可同时实现计算效率和有效的统计推断。通过利用随机投影技术，所提方法将每次迭代的计算成本降低至 $O((d+m)^2)$，其中 $d$ 为决策变量的维数，$m$ 为约束的数量，使其非常适合大规模问题。为克服随机投影和零阶近似给统计推断带来的挑战，我们采用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机投影的免导数随机序列二次规划方法（SDF-SSQP），在无导数信息的等式约束随机优化问题中，将每轮迭代成本降至 $O((d+m)^2)$ 的同时实现有效的在线统计推断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a sketched derivative-free SSQP (SDF-SSQP) method that simultaneously achieves computational efficiency—reducing per-iteration cost to $O((d+m)^2)$—and valid statistical inference for equality-constrained stochastic optimization where derivative information is unavailable.
